description: Three simultaneous, fixed-arm retention and natural release diagnostics. Support withdrawal is not active lift or transport.
support_motion: First descend 40 mm, then continue down to 100 mm total and move 100 mm in world +X to clear the natural drop path; the fixture bottom stays 10 mm above the catch tray.
distance_tolerance_basis: Existing native contact offset 1 mm plus object offset 1 mm and 0.1 mm numerical allowance; measured distances are retained. This does not certify hardware or exact cooked/visible surface equality.
success_scope: Per-size bench contact, unsupported retention >=2 s, and natural release only; no household or policy success. Verdict thresholds frozen in native_contact_verdict.py and bound by SHA256.
arm_drive_rationale: Installed IsaacLab implicit actuator uses PD torque semantics but inherited USD arm drives are inertia-normalized acceleration drives. Controlled comparison changes only six arm drive types in the ephemeral scene. Source asset, gains and 300 Nm diagnostic cap remain unchanged; not hardware calibration.
solver_order_rationale: Omni Physics 107.3 articulation stability guide identifies persistent contact penetration with competing stiff/mimic constraints as a use for solving dynamic articulation contacts later. Isolated scene-only change; 32 position/8 velocity iterations, timestep, all drives and geometry unchanged. Outcome remains a diagnostic.
